card.name: Quantity words before a counted noun
card.fires_on: Words that express an amount or limit just before the thing counted, such as limited, enough, room, six, or a number in a range. Found in general web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Scarcity or amount words
modes.description: Words like limited, room or enough describing how much of a resource is available.
modes.example: struggling to stretch<< limited>> dollars over demands for ever-increasing services

modes.label: Numbers and counts
modes.description: A number or count in a list, range or structure description.
modes.example: Recipe: Best Beef Stew Serves 6 to <<8>> Use a good-quality medium-bodied wine
